notice: SYNTHETIC EVALUATION FIXTURE. Licensed under MIT. All observations are invented for scientific evaluation of complaint classification and clustering algorithms. No real user posts, names or confidential data are included.

metadata.description: 60/40 development and held-out benchmark fixture covering paraphrases, negation, neutral mentions, and cross-source duplicates.

development_split.text: Every Monday our maintainer manually copies release notes into a spreadsheet by hand.
Volunteers waste hours on repetitive manual data entry between systems.
The calendar connector cannot connect to Google Calendar feeds and sync fails.
Missing integration with our existing webhook service forces awkward workarounds.
Search queries are extraordinarily slow and frequently time out under load.
High latency on dashboard loading makes daily triage painful.
The daemon crashes unexpectedly and keeps failing after restart.
Encountering intermittent fatal errors during background synchronization.
Setup has too many steps and the documentation is confusing for newcomers.
The onboarding wizard is cumbersome and complicated to navigate.
I really wish there was support for keyboard shortcuts and arrow navigation.
Missing feature: no way to export chart visualisations directly to SVG.
The hosted tier is too costly and expensive for bootstrapped non-profits.
Hidden fees make the recurring subscription price unreasonable.
Customer support ignores critical tickets and leaves questions unanswered for weeks.
The documentation is well-organized and setup is completely painless.
Our database is not slow and never crashes during heavy ingestion.
Reviewing standard pricing tiers and feature comparisons on the home page.

held_out_split.text: Our triage team spends 4 hours every Tuesday re-typing issue data into markdown tables by hand.
Repetitive copy pasting of release metadata between Git and Slack wastes developer focus.
The application does not connect to custom LDAP authentication providers.
API sync missing: we cannot bridge customer tickets directly to GitHub issues.
Full-text search takes forever to return and response latency spikes drastically.
The UI is lagging severely when rendering tables larger than 100 rows.
The worker service keeps failing under load and produces repeated crash backtraces.
Major outage yesterday due to broken schema migration scripts.
The installation pipeline is complicated and has far too many steps for beginners.
Configuring reverse proxy SSL certificates is confusing and cumbersome.
We desperately wish it had a dark mode toggle and screen-reader accessibility options.
Missing feature: no native way to filter logs by HTTP status code.
Enterprise licensing is exorbitantly overpriced and we cannot afford the minimum seats.
Billing surprise with hidden fees added for bandwidth consumption.
Support gives unhelpful support responses and closes active bug reports without review.
The new update is not broken and doesn't crash on arm64 macOS machines.
Announcing our new community roadmap and quarterly contributor goals.
Fast responses, clean code structure, and straightforward setup without complicated steps.
